title: evals/replay absorbs the old harnesses' live driver and grading
body:
Why: ADR 0021 point 6 folds three harnesses into evals/replay; the runner, arms and row format exist, the old harnesses remain.
Outcome: scripts/outside-acceptance.ts, scripts/outside-testgrade.ts and evals/d23/harness.ts are deleted after evals/replay carries their live session driver, workspace preparation (arm B static CLAUDE.md, arm C KRN) and grading; their tests move to test/evals/replay-*.
Proof: `node evals/replay/run.ts --arms C --units 1 --dry: 1 row` and `test ! -e scripts/outside-acceptance.ts`.
